about.title: About ToolHub
about.intro: ToolHub (toolhub.ai.kr) is a free collection of web tools: everyday calculators for salary, tax and loans, developer tools, image and media tools, health calculators and games. Everything runs in your browser with no sign-up or install.

sections.title: Rules and sources behind the numbers
items: Values set by law or official notice (tax, social insurance, minimum wage, lending rules) are calculated from official sources such as the Korea Law Information Center, the National Tax Service, the National Pension Service, the National Health Insurance Service, the Ministry of Employment and Labor and the Financial Services Commission.
Income tax in the take-home pay calculator uses the National Tax Service simplified withholding tax table, the same table employers use for payroll.
Each tool states the year and source it applies, on screen or in its guide, and is updated when rates or tax law change.
Results are for reference. Actual amounts can differ with personal circumstances or an agency's review, so confirm with the relevant agency before filing, borrowing or signing anything important.

sections.title: Where does your input go?
items: Calculators and most tools process your input only inside your browser. Photo and document editing also happens on your device, and any feature that needs a server says so on screen.
Recent calculations, favorites and display settings are stored only in your browser.
Only shared features (game rankings and matches, inquiries, anonymous salary statistics) are recorded on our servers. See the Privacy Policy for details.

sections.title: How we stay free
paragraphs: ToolHub runs without sign-ups or payments and covers its costs with Google AdSense ads. Ads never affect calculation results.

sections.title: Report an error or contact us
paragraphs: If a calculation is wrong or a law change is missing, please tell us and we will fix it. Suggestions for new tools are welcome too.
